A MECHANIC WAS PERFORMING MX RUN-UP ON A STRAIGHT NAVAJO, WHEN BOTH ENGINES QUIT DUE TO FUEL STARVATION.  PRIOR TO THE RUN, HE HAD CHECKED FUEL QUANTITY INDICATORS, WHICH SHOWED ONE-FOURTH TANK IN EACH MAIN TANK.  THE MAIN (INBOARD) TANK HAS 2 SENDERS, AN INBOARD (40648-03) AND AN OUTBOARD (40648-02);  INBOARD SENDER IS LONGER THAN OUTBOARD.  INVESTIGATION SHOWED THAT IN THIS ACFT, THE 2 SENDERS HAD BEEN SWITCHED.  WHEN LONGER SENDER IS PUT IN OUTBOARD LOCATION, IT WILL HIT BOTTOM OF TANK, GIVING A FALSE ONE-FOURTH FULL INDICATION.  THIS IS SECOND TIME THIS CONDITION HAS BEEN FOUND IN THE LAST 6 WEEKS.  WHILE BOTH INCIDENTS INVOLVED 31-310'S, PARTS, & POTENTIAL FOR PROBLEM, IS SAME IN PA31350 CHIEFTANS.
